newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle sell $105/dressed, up $1 -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle sell $105/dressed, up $1 -USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers was fairly active, with opening sales fully steady, instances $1.00 per cwt higher, USDA said. Buyer inquiry was good and seller interest uneven. Sales confirmed - 5,000 For the week - 63,000.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 104.00, instances 105.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 104.00, few 105.00.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
